newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 13.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 13.

text.p: * Travelers Group Inc , Hewlett-Packard Co, Johnson & Johnson and Wal-Mart Stores Inc are expected to move higher Thursday after the Wall Street Journal said it would add them to the Dow Jones Industrial Average effective March 17.
Analysts forecast declines in the four stocks being dropped from the index: Westinghouse Electric Corp, Texaco Inc, Bethlehem Steel Corp and Woolworth Corp.
Hewlett-Packard climbed 3/8 to 55 in London and Johnson and Johnson gained 3/8 to 60. Texaco was down 1-1/4 at 101-1/2, Bethlehem fell 1/4 to $8-1/2, and Westinghouse fell 3/8 to 18-5/8.
Dealers said the negative impact on Woolworth was blunted by the company's announcement of good fourth-quarter results and a strong outlook. The shares were down 1/4 at 22-3/4.

* General Motors Corp fell 3/8 to 57-3/8 in London after releasing a financial breakdown of its auto-building operations and its Delphi auto parts unit, in preparation for the sale of 20 percent of Delphi.
Other motor shares came off in sympathy. Ford Motor Co fell 1/4 to 32-1/2 and Chrysler Corp lost 1/4 to 31-1/8.
